description: Department of Imports & Exports - Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 06 of 2022
reasoning: This gazette contains new regulations promulgated under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969, which establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for import control. It creates specific licensing requirements and amends existing regulations, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for regulatory matters and statutory instruments. While it mentions the Minister of Finance, it does so only in the context of his legal authority to promulgate regulations, not detailing his portfolio responsibilities or making personnel changes.
